raw_site_text: Enrollment of study participants took place at CFO's Manila PDOS location
justification: Participants were recruited and the randomized pre-departure seminars delivered at 'CFO's Manila PDOS location'; outcomes were followed in the U.S. and via Philippine households.
note: Follow-up surveys include proxy interviews with family in the Philippines (locations not given) and outcomes occur in the U.S.; only the Manila intervention/enrollment site is mapped.
